description:
Cast Machine God's Effigy by paying {4}. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Machine God's Effigy enters, it and Grinding Station trigger. 
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Machine God's Effigy by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Machine God's Effigy.
Resolve the Machine God's Effigy trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Machine God's Effigy from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.
